summary.text: Melissa Ballard is a Republican state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 20 who has served since January 1, 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Melissa Ballard succeeded Becky Edwards as the representative for District 20.

Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as the House Education Committee and the Transportation Committee in 2019-2022, and the House Economic Development and Workforce Services Committee, the House Education Committee and the Law Enforcement and Criminal Justice Committee in 2023-2024.
Her Republican primary on June 23, 2026 was canceled.
